title: rosa urbica f. perciliata
intro: Rosa urbica f. perciliata, commonly known as Rosa urbica f. perciliata or urban wild rose, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Rosaceae. The health benefits of Rosa urbica f. perciliata include its potential to treat various digestive issues and its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in traditional medicine to treat stomach problems, diarrhea, and fever, as well as its potential application in the treatment of skin conditions. Bioactive constituents of Rosa urbica f. perciliata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
